videos.name: Tam süreç
videos.alt: The whole painting of sept neuf in 30 seconds, filmed while it is painted: a drawing on a white canvas becomes a violet figure in a mint armchair with a pale bird on a side table.

videos.name: Sabit önden timelapse
videos.alt: A fixed front view of sept neuf as a 30-second timelapse: green ground, the seated figure, the bird on the side table, hands passing over the canvas.

videos.name: İki parça · 1 (kayıt 01–07)
videos.alt: The first half of painting sept neuf, recordings 1 to 7: the drawing, the green ground and the first colour on the figure.

videos.name: İki parça · 2 (kayıt 08–14)
videos.alt: The second half of painting sept neuf, recordings 8 to 14: the violet figure, the mint armchair and the bird take shape.
